title_zh: 免費網上培訓：從文字到接觸——現代醫療的專業界線管理（12 月 18 日，Jennifer Piel）
title_en: Harborview TeleBehavioral Health webinar professional boundaries modern healthcare December 2026
summary_zh: 華盛頓大學 Harborview 行為健康研究所免費每月 TeleBehavioral Health 網上講座系列，2026 年 12 月 18 日星期五 11:00–12:00（太平洋時間，約香港時間 12 月 19 日 03:00–04:00），由 Jennifer Piel（醫學博士、法學博士）主講「從文字到接觸：現代醫療的專業界線管理」。系列開放予所有為精神健康與物質使用人士提供服務者，以 Zoom 舉行，每場須個別登記。費用全免。
summary_en: The University of Washington's Harborview Behavioral Health Institute runs a free monthly TeleBehavioral Health webinar series; the next session is Friday 18 December 2026, 11:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. Pacific time (about 3:00-4:00 a.m. Hong Kong time on 19 December), with Jennifer Piel, MD, JD, presenting 'From Text to Touch: Managing Professional Boundaries in Modern Healthcare'. The series is open to anyone providing services to people living with mental health and substance use issues, is held on Zoom, and each session needs separate registration. Attendance is free.
